newsitem.title: USA: Anacomp says sets rights plan worth $25 mln.
newsitem.headline: Anacomp says sets rights plan worth $25 mln.

text.p: Anacomp Inc said it would offer rights to its shareholders, for estimated net proceeds of about $25 million if all the rights were exercised.
Anacomp said in a statement it would use the funds for acquisitions of businesses and technologies.

The company said it intended to distribute to shareholders of record as of the close of business on September 18 transferable rights to subscribe for the purchase of about 3.6 milllion shares of common stock.
The company said it had set a subscription price of $6.875 per share, a discount of about 20 percent from the stock's closing price of $8.625 on September 9, the date on which the terms were set.
Anacomp shareholders of record would receive 0.36 rights to puchase shares of common stock for each share of common stock held on the record date, the company said.
Magten Asset Management Corp, whose investment advisory client accounts held about 29 percent of Anacomp stock, told the company these accounts intended to exercise the rights, Anacomp said.

Holders who exercised all their rights also had oversubscription privileges to subscribe to remaining unpurchased shares, with a maximum of two additional shares for each share subscribed for the first time, Anacomp said.
The rights would expire on Octover 21.
Anacomp provides multiple-media data management solutions.
